fusions.name: Brood Cells
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Mud-Dauber's Errand
fusions.desc: Sends a bee at the first enemy it meets, which deals 11 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then carries your afflictions on that enemy to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swarm Lodge
fusions.desc: After a 0.4-second cast, builds a hive for 12 seconds. Every second its swarm stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Industry of the Comb
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
